name: Gemma 4 31B

attrs.author: Google
attrs.summary: This model excels at multimodal reasoning across screenshots, documents, diagrams, and design assets. Ideal for visual agentic workflows, image-aware copilots, and teams migrating from closed multimodal APIs to an open model.

notes: Image inputs are only available in Chat Completions. The Completions endpoint does not support image inputs.

Reasoning is disabled by default for Gemma 4. Use reasoning_effort to control it in Chat Completions. Gemma 4 does not support raw or hidden reasoning formats today. See the reasoning guide for details.
See the Image Inputs guide for limits and token behavior.
Structured outputs and tool calling with strict: true (constrained decoding) is supported for this model.
